CA.name: Wild geranium
CA.citation: Wikipedia; native range confirmed to include southern Manitoba and southwestern Quebec. True Geranium genus, distinct from the South African Pelargonium (common garden/bedding 'geranium'); also distinct from 'wood cranesbill'/'woodland geranium', which properly refers to the European Geranium sylvaticum
